title: Cam Skattebo: I try to fight for extra yards, it bit me on Sunday

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Cam Skattebo: I try to fight for extra yards, it bit me on Sunday
sources.description: The Giants didn't win on Sunday, but running back Cam Skattebo still let out "a sigh of relief" when the clock ran out in overtime against the Commanders in Washington.
